Botanica Modern Sea Karon

Villa in Karon
HomeSaleBotanica Modern Sea Karon

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions). Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Botanica Modern Sea Karon is a hillside villa project in Karon by Botanica Luxury Phuket, designed in a modern tropical style. The developer's factsheet lists two-storey four-bedroom, four-bathroom pool villas of about 622 to 737 sqm on plots of 386 to 704 sqm, each with a 10 by 4 m pool and two parking spaces. All villas except plot 9 are described as sea-view. FazWaz lists 27 villas on about 17,600 sqm (other sources list 8 or 24).

FazWaz lists a communal garden, parking, 24-hour security and CCTV; common-area fees of THB 20 per sqm per month with a THB 100,000 sinking fund; pets allowed. Listing pages also mention a clubhouse and playground, which the developer page does not confirm.

FazWaz measures Karon Beach at about 1.8 km, Kata Beach 4.2 km and Kata Noi Beach 6.8 km in a straight line, with Patong Hospital about 8.8 km away. Completion is given as 2026 by one source and 2027 by another, so no date is stated. The developer advertises prices from THB 47.8 million to 88.39 million; ask us for current availability.
